description: Movement library metadata for Tibi (Cobalt Sculpt). Kinematics are in src/studio/kits/fitness/exercises.js under the same ids. The 12 upper-body exercises come from the verified research of projects/upper-body-workout (research.md table, dossier claims c14-c26): muscles name the main contributors from standard texts (NSCA Essentials 4e; OpenStax A&P 2e), cues and alternatives are coaching guidance, not research findings. No activation percentages; no exercise isolates one muscle.
kinematics_note: Joint angles are authored from typical ranges, not measured motion capture. Label any on-screen angle 'illustrative' unless a cited study supplies it.

landmarks.foot: ball of the foot (first metatarsal head)

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.start: Hands just outside shoulder width, body one straight line from head to heels (ribs down, glutes tight).

phases.description: Lower the chest to the floor with elbows angled back, not flared straight out.
Push the floor away and finish with the shoulder blades spread around the ribcage.

muscles.fibres: pectoralis-major; triceps-brachii; deltoid (anterior fibres) / serratus anterior; rectus-abdominis and external-oblique (trunk hold)

exercises.direction: Push the floor away and finish with the shoulder blades spread around the ribcage.
exercises.camera: side view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Hands on a raised bench or table; knee push-up. Harder: Feet raised; slower lowering; added weight.

errors.description: Hips sag or pike and reps stop halfway.

cues: Hands just outside shoulder width, body one straight line from head to heels (ribs down, glutes tight).
Lower the chest to the floor with elbows angled back, not flared straight out.
Push the floor away and finish with the shoulder blades spread around the ribcage.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.start: Set the shoulder blades back and down against the bench, feet planted.

phases.description: Lower until the dumbbells are beside the chest with forearms vertical over the elbows.
Press up and slightly in, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso rather than flared wide.

muscles.fibres: pectoralis-major; triceps-brachii; deltoid (anterior fibres) / serratus anterior; biceps-brachii (long head, stabiliser)

exercises.direction: Press up and slightly in, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso rather than flared wide.
exercises.camera: side view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Floor press (shorter range); push-up variations. Harder: Incline bench; slower lowering; heavier dumbbells.

errors.description: Elbows flared straight out to the sides.
errors.correction: Aim for about 45 degrees between the upper arm and the torso.

errors.description: Bouncing the dumbbells off the chest.
errors.correction: Lower under control and pause briefly at the bottom.

cues: Set the shoulder blades back and down against the bench, feet planted.
Lower until the dumbbells are beside the chest with forearms vertical over the elbows.
Press up and slightly in, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso rather than flared wide.

variations.name: Neutral-grip press
variations.note: palms facing; often friendlier to the shoulder

variations.name: Incline press
variations.note: bench raised; more clavicular chest and front shoulder

execution: Sit with the dumbbells on the thighs, lie back and kick them to the chest.
Set the shoulder blades back and down against the bench, feet planted.
Lower under control until the dumbbells are beside the chest, forearms vertical over the elbows.
Press up and slightly in until the arms are straight over the shoulders.
Pause at lockout, then repeat.
exercises.breathing: Inhale on the way down, exhale as you press (a common convention); avoid holding the breath for long.
visual_requirements: a FULL repetition: lockout, lowering, bottom, press, lockout
dumbbell path as a slight arc
shoulder blades stay down on the bench
chest highlighted prime, triceps and front shoulder helpers

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
exercises.start: Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows throughout.

phases.description: Open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a controlled stretch across the chest, no lower than you can control.
Bring the dumbbells back as if hugging a barrel.

muscles.fibres: pectoralis-major / deltoid (anterior fibres); biceps-brachii (stabiliser); serratus anterior

exercises.direction: Bring the dumbbells back as if hugging a barrel.
exercises.camera: above view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Resistance-band fly; lighter dumbbells. Harder: Incline bench; slow lowering; pause at the bottom.

errors.description: Straightening or bending the elbows through the rep so it turns into a press, or using a weight too heavy to control at the bottom.

cues: Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows throughout.
Open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a controlled stretch across the chest, no lower than you can control.
Bring the dumbbells back as if hugging a barrel.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.start: Start from a hang with the shoulder blades gently pulled down, not shrugged.

phases.description: Pull the elbows down toward the ribs until the chin clears the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.

muscles.fibres: latissimus-dorsi; biceps-brachii; brachialis / trapezius (lower and middle fibres); rhomboids; deltoid (posterior fibres); forearm-flexors (grip)

exercises.direction: Lower under control to a full hang.
exercises.camera: back view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Band-assisted pull-up; slow lowering only (negatives); inverted row. Harder: Slower tempo; pause at the top; added weight.

errors.description: Swinging or kicking for momentum and cutting the range short.

cues: Start from a hang with the shoulder blades gently pulled down, not shrugged.
Pull the elbows down toward the ribs until the chin clears the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.start: Support one hand and knee on the bench, back flat and hips level.

phases.description: Pull the elbow toward the hip rather than straight up, shoulder blade moving with the arm.
Lower to a full stretch without twisting the torso.

muscles.fibres: latissimus-dorsi; rhomboids; trapezius (middle fibres); deltoid (posterior fibres) / biceps-brachii; brachialis; forearm-flexors (grip); erector-spinae (trunk position)

exercises.direction: Lower to a full stretch without twisting the torso.
exercises.camera: side view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Chest-supported row on an incline bench; resistance-band row. Harder: Pause at the top; slower lowering; heavier dumbbell.

errors.description: Twisting and heaving the torso to swing the weight, with a shortened range.

cues: Support one hand and knee on the bench, back flat and hips level.
Pull the elbow toward the hip rather than straight up, shoulder blade moving with the arm.
Lower to a full stretch without twisting the torso.

exercises.name: Chest-supported rear-delt fly
exercises.start: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and a soft bend in the elbows.

phases.description: Lead with the elbows, raising the arms out to shoulder height as if pulling them apart.
Lower slowly; use light dumbbells.

muscles.fibres: deltoid (posterior fibres); rhomboids; trapezius (middle fibres) / rotator cuff (infraspinatus, teres minor); erector-spinae (trunk position)

exercises.direction: Lower slowly; use light dumbbells.
exercises.camera: top view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Chest-supported on an incline bench; resistance-band pull-apart. Harder: Slower lowering; pause at the top.

errors.description: Heaving the torso up and down, or letting the elbows travel behind the body so it becomes a row.

cues: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and a soft bend in the elbows.
Lead with the elbows, raising the arms out to shoulder height as if pulling them apart.
Lower slowly; use light dumbbells.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell overhead press
exercises.start: Sit upright with the dumbbells at shoulder height and forearms vertical.

phases.description: Press up until the arms are nearly straight overhead, ribs down so the lower back does not arch.
Lower under control to shoulder height.

muscles.fibres: deltoid (anterior and lateral fibres); triceps-brachii / trapezius (upper fibres); serratus anterior; pectoralis-major (clavicular fibres)

exercises.direction: Lower under control to shoulder height.
exercises.camera: front view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: One arm at a time; pike push-up (no equipment). Harder: Standing; slower lowering; heavier dumbbells.

errors.description: Arching the lower back and pressing forward instead of overhead.

cues: Sit upright with the dumbbells at shoulder height and forearms vertical.
Press up until the arms are nearly straight overhead, ribs down so the lower back does not arch.
Lower under control to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.start: Hold light dumbbells at the sides with a soft elbow bend.

phases.description: Lead with the elbows, raising the arms out to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly rather than dropping.

joints: shoulder abduction to about shoulder height

muscles.fibres: deltoid (lateral fibres); rotator cuff (supraspinatus) / trapezius (upper fibres); serratus anterior

exercises.direction: Lower slowly rather than dropping.
exercises.camera: front view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Lighter weight; resistance-band raise; seated. Harder: Slower lowering; pause at the top; one arm leaning away from a post.

errors.description: Swinging the weights up with the legs and trunk, or shrugging.
errors.correction: Use lighter dumbbells, keep the trunk still, think elbows up and out.

cues: Hold light dumbbells at the sides with a soft elbow bend.
Lead with the elbows, raising the arms out to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly rather than dropping.

variations.name: Leaning lateral raise
variations.note: a slight side lean lengthens the lever at the start

execution: Stand tall with light dumbbells at the sides, a soft bend in the elbows.
Lead with the elbows, raising the arms out to the sides.
Stop at about shoulder height; do not shrug.
Lower slowly rather than dropping, to just off the thighs.

tempo.note: illustrative; slower lowering is a coaching preference

exercises.breathing: Exhale as you raise, inhale as you lower (a common convention).
visual_requirements: arms abduct in the frontal plane to shoulder height

exercises.name: Prone Y-raise
exercises.start: Lie chest-down on an incline bench (about 30-45 degrees) with arms hanging, thumbs up.

phases.description: Raise the arms diagonally into a Y alongside the ears, shoulder blades gliding down away from the ears.
Use very light weight, or none, and lower slowly.

joints: shoulder flexion and abduction into a Y

muscles.fibres: trapezius (lower and middle fibres); deltoid (posterior fibres) / rhomboids; serratus anterior; rotator cuff (infraspinatus)

exercises.direction: Use very light weight, or none, and lower slowly.
exercises.camera: top view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: No weight, on the floor face-down; wall slides. Harder: Light dumbbells; pause at the top.

errors.description: Shrugging toward the ears and arching the lower back to lift.

cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench (about 30-45 degrees) with arms hanging, thumbs up.
Raise the arms diagonally into a Y alongside the ears, shoulder blades gliding down away from the ears.
Use very light weight, or none, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.start: Sit back on an incline bench (about 45-60 degrees) with the arms hanging straight down.

phases.description: Curl with the elbows pointing at the floor rather than swinging forward.
Lower all the way down to a full stretch.

joints: elbow flexion with the shoulder extended
exercises.direction: Lower all the way down to a full stretch.
exercises.camera: side view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Standing dumbbell curl; resistance-band curl. Harder: Slower lowering; one arm at a time; pause at the bottom.

errors.description: Elbows drifting forward and swinging the shoulders to lift, or cutting off the bottom of the rep.

cues: Sit back on an incline bench (about 45-60 degrees) with the arms hanging straight down.
Curl with the elbows pointing at the floor rather than swinging forward.
Lower all the way down to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell curl
exercises.start: Stand tall with the dumbbells at the sides, palms forward, elbows by the ribs.

phases.description: Bend the elbows to bring the dumbbells up without the upper arms swinging forward.
Lower all the way down under control.

exercises.direction: The dumbbells travel in an arc in front of the body; the elbows stay put.
exercises.camera: side view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: The easier swap for the incline dumbbell curl (research claim c24).

errors.description: Swinging the torso or the elbows forward to move the weight.
errors.correction: Brace the trunk, pin the elbows to the ribs, use a lighter weight.

errors.description: The elbows drift forward as the weight rises.
errors.correction: Keep the elbows beside the ribs; if they drift, the load is too heavy.

variations.name: Alternating curl
variations.note: one arm at a time; same cues

variations.name: Hammer curl (neutral grip)
variations.note: shifts work toward brachialis and brachioradialis

variations.name: Incline dumbbell curl
variations.note: starts with the arm behind the body (stretched biceps); see incline-curl

execution: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight, palms forward.
Pin the upper arms beside the ribs and keep the trunk still.
Bend the elbows to bring the dumbbells toward the shoulders; only the forearm moves.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze.
Lower slowly to full elbow extension and repeat.

joint_actions.note: coaching cue: the upper arm should barely move

tempo.note: about 3 s per rep in the demo; slower lowering is a coaching preference, not a measured optimum

exercises.breathing: Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower (a common coaching convention).
visual_requirements: upper arm stays beside the ribs the whole rep
elbow angle changes from near straight to deeply bent
biceps highlighted as prime mover, brachialis as helper

harder: incline curl for a stretched start

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
exercises.start: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, upper arms close to the ears, ribs down.

phases.description: Lower behind the head until you feel a stretch in the back of the upper arm.
Extend back up to nearly straight arms.

joints: elbow flexion then extension with the shoulder flexed overhead

muscles.fibres: triceps-brachii / deltoid and rotator cuff (arm position); rectus-abdominis and erector-spinae (trunk position)

exercises.direction: Extend back up to nearly straight arms.
exercises.camera: side view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Resistance-band overhead extension; seated with back support. Harder: Slower lowering; one arm at a time.

errors.description: Elbows flaring wide and the lower back arching to push the weight up.

cues: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, upper arms close to the ears, ribs down.
Lower behind the head until you feel a stretch in the back of the upper arm.
Extend back up to nearly straight arms.

exercises.name: Parallel-bar dip
exercises.start: Support yourself on straight arms with the shoulders pulled down, not shrugged.

phases.description: Lower with a controlled lean until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor or only as deep as feels comfortable.
Press back up to straight arms.

muscles.fibres: triceps-brachii; pectoralis-major (lower fibres); deltoid (anterior fibres) / serratus anterior; trapezius (lower fibres)

exercises.direction: Press back up to straight arms.
exercises.camera: side view (the motion stays in the picture plane)
exercises.alternatives: Easier: Band-assisted dip; close-grip push-up; feet-on-floor bench dip with a small range. Harder: Slower lowering; added weight.

errors.description: Dropping so deep the shoulders roll forward, shrugging, or swinging the legs.

cues: Support yourself on straight arms with the shoulders pulled down, not shrugged.
Lower with a controlled lean until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor or only as deep as feels comfortable.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.start: Standing tall, feet about shoulder width.

phases.description: Hips and knees flex together, heels down.
Back to standing.

joints: hip, knee and ankle flexion then extension
exercises.direction: Hips down and back, knees forward over the toes.
exercises.camera: Side view.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.start: Standing tall on the whole foot.

phases.description: Heels rise; the toes stay flat and bend at the ball.
Heels lower under control.

exercises.direction: Straight up over the ball of the foot.
exercises.camera: Side view.

variations.name: Seated calf raise
variations.note: knee bent: the soleus is loaded, the gastrocnemius is slack

variations.name: Single-leg calf raise
variations.note: doubles the load on one leg

execution: Stand tall on the balls of the feet, knees straight, a dumbbell at each side.
Rise as high as you can on the toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower the heels slowly to a full stretch.

joint_actions.note: textbook: a straight knee loads the gastrocnemius

exercises.breathing: Breathe normally; do not hold your breath.
visual_requirements: the ball of the foot stays planted
calf shown from behind and in profile

harder: slow lowering with a pause in the stretch

exercises.name: Walking gait cycle
exercises.start: Mid-flight or initial contact; the loop has eight keys per stride.

phases.description: Foot meets the ground ahead of the body.
Body passes over the stance foot; knee and ankle flex to absorb load.
Hip and ankle extend; the foot leaves the ground.
Knee flexes and the leg swings forward for the next contact.

exercises.direction: Treadmill-style: the figure stays in place and the floor scrolls at the belt speed the kit computes from the stance phase.
exercises.camera: Side view (sagittal).
exercises.cadence: about 110 steps per minute in the loop (illustrative)

errors.description: Foot lands far ahead of the body with a straight knee. Do not claim a foot-strike pattern prevents injury; the evidence is mixed.

exercises.kinematics_source: Typical sagittal ranges after Novacheck TF (1998) Gait Posture 7:77-95; shaped by eye.

exercises.name: Running gait cycle (jog)
exercises.start: Mid-flight or initial contact; the loop has eight keys per stride.

phases.description: Foot meets the ground ahead of the body.
Body passes over the stance foot; knee and ankle flex to absorb load.
Hip and ankle extend; the foot leaves the ground.
Knee flexes and the leg swings forward for the next contact.

exercises.direction: Treadmill-style: the figure stays in place and the floor scrolls at the belt speed the kit computes from the stance phase.
exercises.camera: Side view (sagittal).
exercises.cadence: about 165 steps per minute in the loop (illustrative)

errors.description: Foot lands far ahead of the body with a straight knee. Do not claim a foot-strike pattern prevents injury; the evidence is mixed.

exercises.kinematics_source: Typical sagittal ranges after Novacheck TF (1998) Gait Posture 7:77-95; shaped by eye.

exercises.name: Sprinting gait cycle
exercises.start: Mid-flight or initial contact; the loop has eight keys per stride.

phases.description: Foot meets the ground ahead of the body.
Body passes over the stance foot; knee and ankle flex to absorb load.
Hip and ankle extend; the foot leaves the ground.
Knee flexes and the leg swings forward for the next contact.

exercises.direction: Treadmill-style: the figure stays in place and the floor scrolls at the belt speed the kit computes from the stance phase.
exercises.camera: Side view (sagittal).
exercises.cadence: about 200 steps per minute in the loop (illustrative)

errors.description: Foot lands far ahead of the body with a straight knee. Do not claim a foot-strike pattern prevents injury; the evidence is mixed.

exercises.kinematics_source: Typical sagittal ranges after Novacheck TF (1998) Gait Posture 7:77-95; shaped by eye.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.start: Sit with the knees bent to about 90 degrees, a dumbbell on each thigh just above the knee, the balls of the feet on the floor.

phases.description: Rise onto the toes.
Lower the heels to a full stretch.

exercises.direction: The heels rise; the knees rise with them and the load rides the thighs.
exercises.camera: side view

errors.description: Bouncing out of the bottom.
errors.correction: Pause in the stretch and lift smoothly.

execution: Sit with the knees bent to about 90 degrees and the load on the thighs.
Rise onto the toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower to a full stretch.

joint_actions.note: textbook: a bent knee shortens the gastrocnemius so the soleus does more of the work

visual_requirements: knee visibly bent at about 90 degrees

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.start: Bar across the upper back, feet about shoulder-width, toes turned out slightly, trunk braced.

phases.description: Sit down and back, knees tracking over the toes, bar over the midfoot.
Drive up through the whole foot.

exercises.direction: Hips and knees travel together; the bar moves straight up and down over the midfoot.
exercises.camera: side view for depth and bar path; front for knee tracking

errors.description: Heels lift off the floor.
errors.correction: Sit back, keep the whole foot planted, or work on ankle mobility.

errors.description: Knees collapse inward.
errors.correction: Push the knees out along the line of the toes.

variations.name: Knees blocked at the toes
variations.note: a restricted variation used in Fry et al. 2003; shifts torque from knee to hip

execution: Unrack the bar, step back, set the feet.
Brace the trunk and take a breath.
Sit down and back, knees over the toes, to about parallel.
Drive up through the whole foot, keeping the bar over the midfoot.
Stand tall and reset.
exercises.breathing: Brace with a breath before the descent and exhale near the top (a common convention).

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.start: Upper back against a bench, feet planted, a barbell across the hips, hips low.

phases.description: Drive the hips up until the torso is level.
Lower the hips under control.

joints: knee about 90 degrees at the top
exercises.direction: The hips travel up and slightly back along an arc around the shoulder-blade contact; the bar rides the hips.
exercises.camera: side view

errors.description: Over-arching the lower back at the top.
errors.correction: Finish with the ribs down and the pelvis tucked slightly; the glutes lock out, not the spine.

errors.description: Feet too far away so the hamstrings take over.
errors.correction: Set the feet so the shins are near vertical at the top.

execution: Sit with the upper back against the bench, the bar over the hips.
Plant the feet, shins about vertical at the top.
Drive the hips up until the torso is level with the thighs.
Squeeze, ribs down, then lower under control.
visual_requirements: shoulder blades stay on the bench edge
glute highlighted as the prime mover
